name: Can I stay in my home during a renovation managed by a general contractor?

mainEntity.name: Can I stay in my home during a renovation managed by a general contractor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Whether you can stay in your home during a renovation depends on the scope and nature of the project. For minor remodels like a single bathroom update, it may be feasible to remain in your home. However, for extensive renovations such as a whole-house remodel, kitchen demolition, or projects involving significant dust, noise, or utility shut-offs, it is generally safer and more comfortable to temporarily relocate. Your general contractor can advise on the best approach based on your specific project details.
acceptedAnswer.description: Staying home during renovation depends on the project's scope. Minor remodels might allow it, but extensive work often requires temporary relocation for safety and comfort.
